Black Pepper Powder Wholesale Price for B2B Buyers

Black pepper powder is ground from dried black peppercorns and is one of the most used seasonings in food production. Tradenest Naturals supplies it to food manufacturers, distributors, importers, restaurants and private label brands. Our black pepper powder wholesale price depends on grade, order volume, packaging and delivery destination. We are happy to help buyers compare black pepper powder price per kg and plan steady bulk supply. The peppercorns are carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers. We clean, grind and sieve them under controlled food-processing conditions. Buyers receive an even powder with a strong aroma, balanced heat and dependable performance from one recipe to the next. Tradenest Naturals is a black pepper powder supplier and exporter based in India. Importers looking for a bulk black pepper powder supplier India can work with us for regular shipments, food production and private label programmes. Request a sample and quotation to confirm your specification.

Product Overview

Black pepper powder is made from the mature, dried berries of the Piper nigrum vine. It brings warm pungency, a spicy aroma and a light citrus-like note. The powder mixes easily into dry blends, sauces, marinades, snacks and ready-to-cook products. We offer a standard commercial grade and can also work to customer specifications. Buyers can choose the packaging format, label design and shipment quantity that fit their operation. Our team reviews each enquiry before confirming price and supply.
  • Clean, finely ground black pepper for food use.
  • Even particle size for consistent blending and dosing.
  • No additives unless a buyer requests an approved custom formulation.
  • Suitable for domestic distribution and export shipments.
  • Available in bulk, wholesale, retail-ready and private label formats.

Sourcing and Processing

We buy black peppercorns through established ingredient supply networks. Our team checks the raw material for appearance, aroma, cleanliness and suitability for grinding, and removes stones, stems and other unwanted particles before processing. The cleaned, dried peppercorns are then ground to the target particle size. Careful grinding limits heat build-up, which helps keep the natural aroma. The powder is sieved to 80-100 mesh for uniformity and packed in food-grade, moisture-resistant packaging. Every batch is identified and recorded. We follow standard operating procedures for cleaning, grinding, sieving, packing and storage, which helps keep repeat orders consistent.

Typical Technical Specifications

Specifications can be adjusted to customer needs and destination-market rules. The values below are our typical commercial profile for black pepper powder.
  • Mesh size: 80-100 mesh.
  • Moisture content: Not more than 10%.
  • Shelf life: 18-24 months in sealed packaging.
  • Appearance: Fine, free-flowing dark brown to black powder.
  • Flavour: Strong, warm, pungent and typical of black pepper.
  • Ingredients: Ground black pepper only, unless otherwise agreed.
  • Processing: Dried peppercorns, cleaned, ground and sieved.
For larger contracts, we can review moisture targets, packing material and labelling before production. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and we recommend approving a sample before placing a final order.

Quality, Documentation, and Standards

Quality starts with raw material selection. Each batch goes through documented inspection steps covering traceability, moisture, cleanliness and appearance. The documents you need depend on the destination country, your use of the product and import rules. We prepare commercial and product documents to match the agreed order. These can include the commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, batch details, product specification sheet and any other shipping documents required. Tradenest Naturals is FSSAI and IEC registered, and we do not claim other certifications. If your market requires specific test parameters, third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. Share your standards, labelling rules and import documents with us, and we will confirm what we can provide before production or dispatch.

Applications

Black pepper powder works hard in both industrial and foodservice recipes. Its strong flavour means small, controlled doses go a long way. The fine powder also disperses well in dry and wet mixing.
  • Seasoning blends for snacks, namkeen, popcorn and French fries.
  • Instant noodle masala, soup mixes and ready-to-cook foods.
  • Marinades, sauces, gravies, dressings and dips.
  • Processed meat, poultry, seafood and plant-based food products.
  • Savoury bakery products, crackers, biscuits and filled snacks.
  • Restaurant, hotel, café and cloud-kitchen food preparation.
  • Private label spice packs and retail seasoning products.
  • Custom spice blends and contract-manufactured food formulations.

Buyer Value

  • Consistent mesh gives repeatable blending and production results.
  • Bulk buying can lower unit cost and simplify procurement.
  • Moisture-resistant packaging helps protect aroma during storage.
  • Flexible pack sizes suit distributors, manufacturers and retail brands.
  • Batch traceability supports purchasing control and quality review.
  • An 18-24 month shelf life helps with inventory planning and export distribution.
  • Custom packaging makes private label and branded launches possible.
  • Dealing with the supplier directly makes specification and quotation talks simpler.

Packaging and Shelf Life

We pack black pepper powder in food-grade, moisture-resistant materials. The right pack depends on order volume, storage conditions, market requirements and transport method. Export orders get packaging suited to handling and international transit. Typical pack sizes are 100 g, 250 g, 500 g, 1 kg, 5 kg, 10 kg and 25 kg. We also supply bulk bags, stand-up pouches, PET jars, HDPE containers and custom printed private label packaging. Each shipment can carry product identification, batch number, manufacturing date, expiry date, net weight, storage instructions and applicable regulatory details. Shelf life is 18-24 months from manufacture when the product stays sealed and is stored correctly. The final figure depends on the agreed packaging format. Keep the powder in a cool, dry, clean place, away from direct sunlight, humidity, heat and strong odours. Close opened packs tightly after each use.

MOQ, Lead Time, Samples, and Quotes

The minimum order quantity for black pepper powder wholesale price is 5 Kg for standard bulk supply. That is low enough for a trial run or a first shipment to test a new market. Private label, printed packaging and custom formulations may need larger quantities, which we confirm after review. Lead time depends on specification and artwork approval, payment terms, packaging, any testing you request and the export documents involved. We confirm the schedule with each quotation. To request a sample or quote, send your quantity, destination country, packaging format, label needs and target application. Please also mention any quality documents or import standards you need. Our team will reply with availability, pricing, sample options and estimated shipping details.

Why Choose Tradenest Naturals?

Tradenest Naturals offers B2B buyers sourcing, bulk packing, private label and export documentation support. We keep specifications clear and supply arrangements practical. Our wider range of powders, spices, seasonings and premixes also helps customers who buy several ingredients from India. Beyond the commodity itself, buyers get a partner that can help with product development, cost planning, packaging choices and repeat supply.

Frequently Asked Buyer Questions

What affects the black pepper powder price per kg?

Price depends on raw material grade, season, order volume, packaging, testing and delivery location. Ask for a current quotation for your exact requirement.

Can you supply bulk ground black pepper for export?

Yes. We supply bulk ground black pepper in export packaging and review destination requirements before confirming the order.

What certifications and quality standards apply?

Tradenest Naturals is FSSAI and IEC registered. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost.

Can you provide private label packaging?

Yes. We offer custom printed packaging and private label support, subject to artwork approval and the agreed quantity.

Can I receive a sample before ordering?

Yes. Buyers can request a sample for sensory, application and specification review. Availability depends on the grade and pack format.

Contact Tradenest Naturals for the current black pepper powder wholesale price, sample availability and export supply options. Share your target volume and technical needs, and we will send a clear quotation built around your application.
